name: Femto Technologies Inc. Common Stock
summary: Femto Technologies Inc. specializes in the creation, promotion, and distribution of its proprietary client relationship management (CRM) software solutions, specifically known as Benefit CRM and Cannabis CRM. Additionally, the company is developing the EZ-G device, a hardware product currently awaiting patent approval, which operates in conjunction with its exclusive software. Established on March 29, 2021, Femto Technologies Inc. maintains its headquarters in Kiryat Motzkin, Israel.
